mission: The group discovers Jacen’s cache was hidden in old offworld survey/GAG storage equipment near the Glasswell, not in a mystical altar. Talon recognizes the storage logic. Ben recognizes the Force wrongness. Sela recognizes the local danger. When they get close enough to scan the outer data layers, Ben confirms what Iressa told them in her dying transmission at the Midpoint: the holocron is unfinished, containing Jacen’s work on Recognition, Deepening, and Holding — exactly the identity-shaping techniques the Vigil intends to weaponize with Aevyn’s help. The SPP function here is embodiment rather than revelation. Ben already knew (from Iressa) what the holocron was for. Seeing the cache, seeing Aevyn already at work on it, makes the threat concrete. There is no way to stop Aevyn from getting at the holocron cleanly. The only options left are rescue (saving Tavi and the locals from what Aevyn’s work is about to break) and denial (keeping Aevyn from leaving with the full prize).
why_now: Chapter 29 occupies the second_plot_point phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: Make Jacen feel like Jacen: mystical insight plus cold logistics. The cache being in old survey equipment is the right Jacen-shaped detail. Ben’s reaction to confirming Iressa was right should be quiet — not horror, but the kind of bracing that comes when a worst case becomes the actual case. Reader-onboarding / grounding note: The Glasswell is not a Sith temple, Jedi ruin, or treasure chamber. It is a natural site Jacen exploited with practical concealment. Plain-language consequence of the SPP confirmation: Aevyn is already cracking it; we are too late to stop him from getting at it; the question now is whether we can save anyone caught underneath, and whether we can deny him the part that matters most.
turning_point: Aevyn begins forcing the cache open. The Glasswell starts to answer.
closing_hook: Aevyn begins forcing the cache open. The Glasswell starts to answer.
setting: Iresh, the Glasswell upper chamber — the entrance to the cavern system beneath the mirror-lake. Pale translucent mineral walls, faintly luminescent. Old offworld survey equipment and a concealed GAG-era storage container near the cache site. Aevyn is already at work when the group arrives.
